_comment: Template, Windows variant (native Windows with Git for Windows; environments/claude-code-windows.md), drafted 2026-11-09, not yet run on a machine: the fragment to MERGE into %USERPROFILE%\.claude\settings.json (~/.claude/settings.json). It is model/settings.json less the sandbox, which does not run on native Windows: Claude Code runs commands unsandboxed there, with no warning, and failIfUnavailable would stop it at startup (the sandboxing page). Changed for Windows: brew and security (macOS) out; winget in; powershell, pwsh and cmd denied from Bash; _netrc beside .netrc; gh's folder is %APPDATA%\GitHub CLI on Windows (gh help environment), in place of ~/.config/gh; Claude Code's own login is the file ~/.claude/.credentials.json on Windows (the authentication page), not the Keychain. The PowerShell tool is turned off by env: with Git Bash it is on by default for claude.ai and Console accounts, and a Bash rule does not restrict it (the tools reference). Paths are written ~/… as in the Mac model; the docs do not say how ~ expands on Windows or how a space in a rule's path is matched, so the checks try a deny line on the machine (environments/claude-code-windows.md). Everything else as model/settings.json's comment says.
